title: Fail to build grpcio_reflection when using grpc as bazel external dependence
body:

### What version of gRPC and what language are you using?
 gRPC 1.48.0
Python

### What operating system (Linux, Windows,...) and version?
Ubuntu 20.04

### What runtime / compiler are you using (e.g. python version or version of gcc)
Python 3.8.10
gcc 9.4.0

### What did you do?
A minimal demonstration.
```
# WORKSPACE file
load("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl", "http_archive")

_RULES_PYTHON_VERSION = "0.8.0"
http_archive(
    name = "rules_python",
    sha256 = "9fcf91dbcc31fde6d1edb15f117246d912c33c36f44cf681976bd886538deba6",
    strip_prefix = "rules_python-%s" % _RULES_PYTHON_VERSION,
    urls = [
        "https://github.com/bazelbuild/rules_python/archive/refs/tags/%s.tar.gz" % _RULES_PYTHON_VERSION,
    ],
)

GRPC_VERSION = "1.48.0"
http_archive(
    name = "com_github_grpc_grpc",
    sha256 = "9b1f348b15a7637f5191e4e673194549384f2eccf01fcef7cc1515864d71b424",
    strip_prefix = "grpc-%s" % GRPC_VERSION,
    urls = [
        "https://bwh.qingtiantruck.com/externalcache/grpc/grpc/archive/v%s.tar.gz" % GRPC_VERSION,
        "https://github.com/grpc/grpc/archive/v%s.tar.gz" % GRPC_VERSION,
    ],
)

load("@com_github_grpc_grpc//bazel:grpc_deps.bzl", "grpc_deps")
grpc_deps()

load("@com_github_grpc_grpc//bazel:grpc_extra_deps.bzl", "grpc_extra_deps")
grpc_extra_deps()

load("@rules_python//python:pip.bzl", "pip_install")

pip_install(
    name = "grpc_python_dependencies",
    requirements = "@com_github_grpc_grpc//:requirements.bazel.txt",
)
```

running 
```
bazel build -s @com_github_grpc_grpc//src/python/grpcio_reflection/grpc_reflection/v1alpha:reflection_py_pb2_grpc
```
shows
```
ERROR: /home/user/.cache/bazel/_bazel_user/d6d247163069c06dffeeec49a63cc20f/external/com_github_grpc_grpc/src/python/grpcio_reflection/grpc_reflection/v1alpha/BUILD.bazel:24:16: output 'external/com_github_grpc_grpc/src/python/grpcio_reflection/grpc_reflection/v1alpha/reflection_pb2_grpc.py' was not created
ERROR: /home/user/.cache/bazel/_bazel_user/d6d247163069c06dffeeec49a63cc20f/external/com_github_grpc_grpc/src/python/grpcio_reflection/grpc_reflection/v1alpha/BUILD.bazel:24:16: ProtocInvocation external/com_github_grpc_grpc/src/python/grpcio_reflection/grpc_reflection/v1alpha/reflection_pb2_grpc.py failed: not all outputs were created or valid
Target @com_github_grpc_grpc//src/python/grpcio_reflection/grpc_reflection/v1alpha:reflection_py_pb2_grpc failed to build
```

### What did you expect to see?
I'm trying to use grpc_reflection on a bazel project with grpc as external dependency, which should depend on `"@com_github_grpc_grpc//src/python/grpcio_reflection/grpc_reflection/v1alpha:grpc_reflection"`. Such python library will fail to build due to  the above issue.
